subject: What environments should I save for troubleshooting?

messages.author: 80defc9c4046a73b
messages.subject: What environments should I save for troubleshooting?
parts:
If something errors out in my shiny app, I would like to save everything the app knows at the time of the error to a workspace that I can inspect later.

Question 1: does the following capture information exhaustively and non-redundantly (where server and ui are the internal environments for server.R and ui.R, respectively)?

save(.GlobalEnv, server, ui, session,file=tempfile('dumpfile',fileext='rdata',filedir='debug'));

Question 2: where would be a good single place to put the save command so that it is guaranteed to trigger even on unanticipated errors?

Thanks.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: What environments should I save for troubleshooting?
parts: I don't think there's a great place to put such a hook now. But we have a release of Shiny coming up that will make this much easier and also let you interactively debug when errors occur.
